title: GitHub Acceptance assumes AWS to exercise named ThinTurn

comments.author: home
comments.text: GitHub Acceptance assumes chatticus-{environment}-github-acceptance over OIDC. Kernel CI no longer needs a local AWS region for the computer-queue lambda Gherkin. Development ThinTurn deploy creates the role.

comments.author: home
comments.text: GitHub CI stays on mocks. Live named ThinTurn is python/scripts/live_aws_thin_turn.sh (and pytest -m live_aws) from a logged-in shell. The GitHub Acceptance workflow and OIDC role are removed so Actions does not hit AWS.
